reserve_design: Second Monday of each month in 2026 H1, 03:00 UTC; measurement 11 calendar days later. Independent of reviewer outputs. Use the final observed weekday level on/before the target, at most four calendar days earlier, in the ALFRED vintage seven calendar days after the target. Six disjoint measurement windows; temporal dependence remains possible. Retrospective review-arm reserve, outside the tournament, not new forward evidence for the statistical model.
candidate: Keep original model, blind prompt, abstention and allowed width at 1.25. Append target/units, overlapping sample status, comparison of last observation to the eligible vintage in weekdays, and prequential 80% interval hit counts on prior nonoverlapping horizons under the locked estimator. Expose no dates, case identity, benchmark scores or resolutions to the reviewer.
comparison: Named Groq Free model and 512-token cap in both arms. No retries. Run reserve pairs in alternating order in time sequence. Three original Q4 candidate calls reuse archived control decisions, with no causal claim for those three. Ceiling 15 hosted calls; a transport or parse failure records incomplete and stops.
metrics: Official Q4 gate unchanged, all three nonabstaining, positive development total and positive last-case log gain relative to the matched baseline. For the six non-tournament reserve periods calculate equal-weight pinball (a proper quantile loss) on the five declared quantiles. On abstention only for the policy-level comparison assign the naive statistical reference to both arms equally; record coverage and mutually covered comparison separately.
decision: Only advance to a separate no-write prospective test if 3/3 Q4 pass the original gate, all six reserve pairs are evaluable, reserve coverage rises, mean paired reserve loss improves and exact one-sided sign test p <= .05 on nonzero paired improvements. An independent forward window is still necessary for any production promotion. This experiment can never produce a tournament proof.
